'''Valdarion Smite''' is a human in [[Caelan's Rest]] on [[Lapidis Isle]].

==Quotes==
;Gossip
You know who you're speaking to? I am THE Valdarion Smite! Yeah, that's the one!

I am a world-renowned boxer, the champion of Kul Tiras in fact! I haven't been home in about four years now, but I held the title when I was last there!

Such a shame to be drafted like this, huh. Especially a shame to be stuck here..

Oh well, the lads and lasses here are good enough to me, especially with my fame back home.
